text:
Lena (People Ops): Quick escalation: Aidan's BG returned an SSA/SSN mismatch because he has an active credit freeze & an identity-theft police report on file. Recruiter looped in. Need an I-9 path that doesn't force a delayed start.

Chris (Recruiter): Aidan disclosed the freeze during offer. He has a police report (PD-2026-193) and FTC IdentityTheft report. He set the freeze to protect his credit. He prefers to start Monday.

Aidan (New Hire): Hi team 44b I can do whatever helps. I have the police report PDF, FTC report, and a letter from SSA showing a pending fraud alert. I can also visit a partner site (WeWork downtown) for in-person verification if that works.

Maya (Legal): Thanks. For domestic hires with fraud/SSN issues Legal prefers either: (A) in-person I-9 Section 2 at an authorized agent (facilitated partner site) with ID shown and agent attestation, OR (B) SSA written letter confirming identity (SSA Form SSA-LV or field-office confirmation) + notarized affidavit. Video-only is low-preference in these cases because of fraud risk.

Lena (People Ops): Options summary: 1) Authorize in-person agent at WeWork partner (we provide liaison & checklist); 2) Accept SSA field-office letter + notarized affidavit & recorded video; 3) Hold start and delay laptop/benefits until freeze lifted. Thoughts?

Terry (IT): FYI from IT: We can provision cloud-only access and Slack for Day-1. Physical laptop and VPN remain on hold until I-9 Section 2 cleared. I can queue the device and mark courier "hold-for-auth" for up to 5 days.

Aidan (New Hire): WeWork works for me. Which locations are authorized, and what's required when I go?

Lena (People Ops): We'll authorize the downtown WeWork (location ID: WW-RED-03). Facilities-Bot will create a guest appointment and the liaison will meet you. Required: original passport or DL + police report copy + signed liaison attestation. Liaison will complete the Redwood verifier checklist and email HR a scanned attestation.

Facilities-Bot: Guest appointment created for Aidan at WW-RED-03 on Mon 09:30 local. Liaison: K. Ortiz. Instructions sent to liaison and to Aidan via DM.

Maya (Legal): Please ensure the liaison uses this attestation text verbatim and includes their name and employee ID: 

```
I, [Liaison Name], attest that I examined the original identity documents presented by [Candidate Name] in person on [date/time]. I confirm the documents appeared authentic and that I witnessed the candidate sign the attestation. Liaison ID: [ID].
```

Lena (People Ops): Aidan please bring police report (PD-2026-193) + photo ID. Also fill out this intake form so we log the exception: https://forms.redwood.com/i9-fraud-exception (select "in-person-partner").

Chris (Recruiter): I'll confirm with Aidan the 09:30 slot and update the offer notes. Recruiter will also DM the liaison with the candidate phone.

Onboard-Bot: Background case BG-20481 updated -> status: waiting-agent-attestation.

Aidan (New Hire): Slot confirmed. I'll be there 09:30. Thanks for the expedited path. One Q: will benefits and payroll be impacted?

Lena (People Ops): Good Q: benefits enrollment will be put into "pending-docs". If liaison attestation + scanned docs are received within 7 days HR will backdate benefits to start date. Payroll: please make sure W-4 SSN entry matches the police report format (no dashes). Payroll may require a brief verification hold but no permanent delay expected.

Terry (IT): Noted. I'll provision email + Slack now. Laptop hold set. Ping me in this thread once HR marks verified and I'll release the shipment.

Maya (Legal): One more legal note: capture the liaison's photo ID copy in the attestation packet and keep the scanned packet in the secure intake repo for auditability.

Lena (People Ops): Closing the plan: 1) Aidan attends WeWork 09:30 Mon, liaison completes attestation, 2) HR logs attestation and updates BG case, 3) Legal does a quick review, 4) Terry releases laptop and benefits toggle if cleared. Thanks team :white_check_mark:
